name: Independent Contractor Agreement
description: Engages an independent contractor to perform services for a client, covering scope, fees, IP ownership, and termination.

variables.label: Description of Services
variables.description: The work the contractor will perform.

sections.heading: Parties
sections.body: This Independent Contractor Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of {{effective_date}} between {{client_name}}, located at {{client_address}} (the "Client"), and {{contractor_name}}, located at {{contractor_address}} (the "Contractor").

sections.heading: 1. Services
sections.body: The Contractor will provide the following services (the "Services"): {{services_description}}. The Contractor will perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner.

sections.heading: 2. Compensation
sections.body: The Client will pay the Contractor {{fee_amount}} {{fee_basis}} for the Services. The Contractor will invoice the Client, and payment is due within {{payment_terms_days}} days of the invoice date.

sections.heading: 3. Independent Contractor Relationship
sections.body: The Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner, or agent of the Client. The Contractor is responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and benefits, and has no authority to bind the Client.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All work product created by the Contractor in performing the Services is the sole property of the Client upon full payment. The Contractor assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in such work product and will execute documents reasonably necessary to perfect that assignment.

sections.heading: 5. Confidentiality
sections.body: The Contractor will keep the Client's non-public information confidential and use it only to perform the Services, both during and after the term of this Agreement.

sections.heading: 6. Term and Termination
sections.body: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until the Services are complete, unless terminated earlier. Either Party may terminate this Agreement on {{termination_notice_days}} days' written notice. The Client will pay for Services properly performed through the termination date.

sections.heading: 7. Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the {{governing_law}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.
